content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Gurugram University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Gurugram University recruitment?
faq.answer: The application is through a walk-in interview, and the date for the interview is 29 September 2026. There is no separate last date for submitting an application form before the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Driver post?
faq.answer: For the Driver post, candidates need to have passed 10+2 or its equivalent. Additionally, a valid driving license for heavy transport vehicles, held for at least three years, is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Cleaner/Sweeper position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Cleaner/Sweeper position is between 18 years and 42 years, inclusive. Specific age relaxations are not detailed in the provided information.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Driver post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Driver post in this Gurugram University recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Cleaner/Sweeper role?
faq.answer: The Cleaner/Sweeper will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20900/- per month, as per the prevailing HKRN wages.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the available data, no application fee is mentioned for any category. Candidates are advised to confirm this with the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Driver and Cleaner/Sweeper posts will be based on a Walk-in Interview conducted by Gurugram University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for both Driver and Cleaner/Sweeper posts is temporary, with a duration of 6 months as indicated in the brief description.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at Gurugram University, Gurugram, Haryana, 122003. The exact reporting time is on 29 September 2026.
